assignedTasks.title: Message Bubble & Thread Prototyping
assignedTasks.description:
Prototype the complex message state machine. Requirements:
1. Design separate styles for Plain Text, Media, and GIF messages.
2. Prototype the thread connector lines for nested replies.
3. Create state variants for 'Sending', 'Error', and 'Edited' message states.

assignedTasks.title: Responsive Layout Matrix: Mobile vs PC
assignedTasks.description:
Define the layout transition logic. Requirements:
1. Prototype how the Global Room (Mobile) transforms into the Grid Layout (Desktop).
2. Define 'Right Pane' behavior in desktop mode for thread overlays.
3. Verify navigation tab mapping to sidebar links.

assignedTasks.title: Micro-animation Spec: Sparkles & Hearts
assignedTasks.description:
Define the interactive feedback animations. Requirements:
1. Prototype the 'Sparkle' burst effect on message double-tap.
2. Define hearth-reaction pulse sequence.
3. Create transition curves for bottom sheet entry/exit.
